title: First videotaped Grusch interview at Bryce's house
summary: Bryce Zabel tells of First videotaped Grusch interview at Bryce's house, about 2023 at Los Angeles, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So he came over and we, you know, Dave Crush was in, you know, cargo shorts and a t-shirt for this thing.

plain: Bryce Zabel, a man who works in Hollywood, says that in 2023 the first videotaped interview with David Grusch, a former government insider who came forward about secret UFO programmes, was filmed at his house in Los Angeles, with Ross Coulthart and someone named Jared involved. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that Grusch showed up for it in cargo shorts and a t-shirt, a small human detail from the start of a story that, if true, helped bring claims about hidden UFO programmes into public view.
